title: Microsoft's New AI-Powered Search for Windows 11 Redefines File Discovery
summary: Microsoft is revolutionizing file search in Windows 11 with a new AI-powered feature that uses semantic indexing for intuitive, natural language searching. Designed to work offline on specialized Copilot Plus PCs, this feature supports various file types and offers multi-language processing. Initially rolling out on Snapdragon devices, it promises to enhance efficiency and productivity without an internet connection. The introduction of a 'Refine' option adds grammar correction capabilities to the mix. While celebrated for its technological advancements, the limited hardware support and privacy concerns spark intricate debates among users and experts alike.
